title: THE SCORE MULTIPLIER LINES SHOW AND LINE UP
why: the pictures of v35.69: the demo run over card kept its settings line in a hidden row, and the Settings score value sat left of the value column
now: the demo run over card shows settings x under extracted x2; the settings score value lines up with the other values

edits.anchor: if(oc&&o.dm>1) for(i=0;i<ln.length;i++) if(ln[i][0]==='aos'){ ln.splice(i+1,0,['aor aodm','settings x'+(+o.dm).toFixed(2)]); break; }   // v35.xx (cw-dmulshow): the settings multiplier, once, under the score
edits.replacement: if(oc&&o.dm>1) ln.splice(1,0,['aoh','settings x'+(+o.dm).toFixed(2)]);   // v35.xx (cw-dmulfix): the settings multiplier, once, a heading line under extracted x2 (the aor rows are hidden on the restyled card)
